clues: It is home to the world's oldest professional football league club, founded in 1862.
Torvill and Dean, the Olympic ice-dance champions, came from here.
Its Test cricket ground, Trent Bridge, sits on the south bank of its river.
Its football club won the European Cup in 1979 and 1980 under Brian Clough.
It is the East Midlands city of the Robin Hood legend.
